title: crypto2dev_reg.h: FIPS gate inline, shared constants, stub guards
description: Header included by all six registration files. Provides: (1) wolfkm_fips_gate() inline function that calls wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips() and returns -EACCES if not FIPS_OPERATIONAL; (2) WOLFKM_PRIORITY 300 constant; (3) #ifdef WOLFKM_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT guard macros for stub mode; (4) #include chain for wolfkm_compat.h and all wolfCrypt crypto headers needed by registration files.
design: wolfkm_fips_gate() must be static inline so it gets inlined at every call site with zero overhead on the hot path. Under WOLFKM_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT=0 the gate always returns 0 (stub mode — FIPS check is meaningless without wolfCrypt). See DESIGN.md §FIPS Gate.
